story.heading: Our Story
story.paragraph1: We met on a rainy afternoon and haven't stopped talking since. What started as a chance conversation grew into years of laughter, adventure, and quiet Sunday mornings together.
story.paragraph2: Through every season, we've found our favorite place is simply beside each other. Now we can't wait to begin our next chapter surrounded by the people we love most.
